name: lens
title: Lens
blurb: Circular magnifying glass follows cursor, revealing zoomed content within the…
description: Wraps content and creates a circular zoom lens that appears on hover. The lens position tracks pointer movement (or stays fixed), showing zoomed content within a radial mask.
use_when: Product galleries or hero images where hover magnification reveals fine detail without blocking the full view.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or pointer-free interfaces — magnifier requires hover to appear.
a11y: Magnification is visual only; focus and keyboard navigation of child content unaffected.
